## Chapter Twenty-Four

The Lab



Lucas awoke with a start to the familiar surroundings of his room in the complex. Blinking he looked around the dark room, his mind still warring with memories that were not his own. But he quickly found to his relief, his body was responding albeit slowly to his commands. Getting up out of bed a hammer slammed down on his cranium the pain causing him to scream out.

His door opened and Emma and Rolle came in, concern all over their faces as they quickly came to help. “what happened” Emma asked, grabbing his legs out the fetal position Lucas had pulled himself into. “Fucking Head” He gritted out and with a Nod Rolle ran out of the room. Lucas lie there, breathing as the drum beat a fast rhythm to in his head. A moment later Rolle returned with the Doc carrying her medical bag. In between squinting over the pain, he could see the severe look awash with concern on her face. “What’s wrong” she asked, looking him over. “Head” Lucas managed to get out in between the clenched jaw.

Doc wen’t to work checking him over and then shaking her head and mumbling she pulled out a syringe “This will take care of the headache, but I need you in bed for thirty minutes before we do a full workup on you” She finished. Shooting an angry glance at Emma “I told you. , this would be dangerous” she hissed. Pushing the needling into his arm. Again his body had that warm feeling as the pain began to recede, he waited for his vision to go black but it didn’t but his body felt like it was floating and for the next thirty minutes he enjoyed the feeling until the Doc decided it was time to put him through his paces.

He sat there for another half hour letting the Doc check him out, always with a shake of the head or a tsk of her mouth. Finally she finished “Okay, you can move, but I don’t like these readings, I need to get you in the med ward and get a full EKG and that means soon” she admonished, putting away her instruments into the worn black bag, that looked more like a Victorian doctor would carry then a start of the art medical practitioner.

Sally glided into the room, wearing of all things a summer flower pattern dress and red heels, Lucas had no idea where the hell he had found the outfit, but he had to admit it definitely breathed life into the older man. Sally smiled down at Lucas “How is our patient” he asked gently, pushing a strand of hair out of Lucas’s face in a maternal fashion. All the while the Doc stood there glowering at him. “I told you this was not wise, I checked him out and I don’t like what I see. First his pupillary response is off, almost like he has suffered a mild concussion. BP almost off the chart 200/100, he needs to take it easy and I need to run an EEG and an EKG now. Sally nodded, okay lets get him in the lab now and with Emma and Rolles help as Sally fussed over the lot of they moved him into the medical lab and he suffered through the doctors second and more thorough exam. He wasn’t worried exactly, he knew there were supposed to be adverse effects, but he felt a little better from earlier, though he wasn’t sure if it was the drugs or his body recovering.

Sally and the Doc stood over the holo viewer staring at readings from the tests. The Doc even much shorter then Sally looked the more intimidating as her face glowered at the readings. “I should have taken a baseline before he went into the machine, but these readings are not good, he needs to stay out of that damn machine” she whispered to Sally but the quiet room and the acoustics making it still loud enough for Lucas to hear. Sally nodded, looking at the readings but Lucas could see he wasn’t understanding a thing he was looking at.

Lucas stood up, the room swam for a moment and he used the bed to steady himself. “Are we done doc?” he asked and the two looked up at him. “You should be in bed young man” she said quickly coming over, but Lucas waived her off. “There is something I need to show you first” he said moving towards the door a bit unsteadily. Sally grabbed his arm. “Can’t it wait?” he asked again in that maternal tone that was odd coming from the deep Boston construction workers voice.

“This could be important” Lucas said and walked out of the med bay as the doc called after them in protest. Lucas walked down the hall, stopping at the second intersection, closing his eyes he tried to remember the trip to the lab, he searched his mind until he found it, he mentally walked through the path, recalling Joe coming from the Command and Control, Lucas took a right seeing the hallway of Joes time overlapping his own, the wear and tear of the years washing away to show new walls and fresh floors.

He continued down the hall, mentally watching the halls as he moved down them, recalling Joes path he finally ended up facing a wall, the wall in his mind was clean and white but this one, had been battered by decades of wear, the pure white had dulled to a decaying yellow. Lucas passed a hand over the pilled on his right and after a moment a keypad popped out halfway, forcing Lucas to manually finish the path until it was locked in place.

He wiped the pad to clean the glass as it slowly powered up. He blew out a breath of release as the screen booted into a keypad. Closing his eyes he went through the memories finally coming to Joe punching in the code, without opening his, he punched in the keys and held his breath.

At first nothing happened as he and Sally stood there and then with a sound of metal grinding the wall slowly recessed and then slid right revealing a large dark cavernous room. “Viola” Lucas whispered to himself and smiled. He turned to Sally and nodded to him “Call the others” he said.

In a few moments the whole group gathered at the opening with flashlights gawking at the size of the room as light washed over the covered tables and large metal boxes. Lucas walked through the dust covered floors and covered tables, almost like the ghost of the room he envisioned in his head. He could see the doctor with her welder and her devil may care smiled. Now all long gone. Shaking his head, he grabbed a cloth and pulled it off a table watching as dust billowed into the air. Rolle and Emma covered their mouths with a wince as Victoria coughed from the excessive dust now floating in the air. “Let’s get some vacuums and see if we can’t clean this up and see what we have” Emma said, heading for the door again with Rolle in tow.

The next few hours were spent cleaning the room of ceiling debris, dust and covers. Finally, as the group stood in the middle of the room, Lucas surveyed the area seeing it looking more like the lab he saw through joe’s eyes. Emma and Victoria went to work immediately pouring over the tech on the tables and the shelves. Sally turned a disapproving look on Lucas. “I want you rested” he said simply, and Lucas knew he meant to have him stand down. “Sally, I need to go back in, if I can find this with one trip, imagine what else we can learn, the information we have access to is invaluable, I know I hit a rough patch, but I can do this” Lucas protested but Sally shook his head. “Not today, go rest we will see how you are doing tomorrow; I want to get doc’s buy in before we try that again” he said.

It took Lucas two more days before the doc would grant him the ability to go under again, though under extreme protest. That morning he joined the group in the Command and Control, entering in he found a very excited Emma and Victoria talking to each other. He wasn’t sure what they had found in the lab, but whatever it was, had them in a frenzy. They refused to talk until the entire group gathers. Once they had Emma took the lead. “We found a lot of good tech, most of it was useless, way out of date, but there were a few interesting things we might be able to use, but that isn’t what we wanted to tell you about” she started and then Victoria took over, Lucas could see the excited gleam in her eye.

“We found a data trunk” she said to the group of blank stares. “What is that?” asked Sally cocking his head. Victoria sighed, as if having to explain cars to Neanderthal’s. “Okay, so the entire digital infrastructure of the country, communicates in three ways, Wireless, Satellite and finally hardline, the most secure is hardline, that is impossible to get into and only available in ultra-secure facility, meaning the firewalls and security is not as heavy as the others. The government security infrastructure is built on top of the old US one. This facility before it went off the grid was a top-secret facility, so it had a hardline trunk connection, using that we might be able to gain access to all kinds of things, like secret files, archives, email who knows” she said.

Everyone was excited at the prospect, but Emma stepped in “This isn’t an open pipe, there is still security and we will need to setup some extra security otherwise they will be able to trace it back to this node” she said. “But we might be able to get a sneak peek at some of what they are up to” she finished, the excited smile returning to her face, giving her the look of a ten-year-old at Christmas then the hardware genius she was.

Rolle went with the girls to begin clearing the room and setting up what they would need to access the secure data trunk.

While Sally, Doc and Lucas went back to the memory lab. Before he could go in Doc insisted on a final workup as a baseline before he was allowed near the machine.

Sally helped him get strapped in, Lucas shot him a reassuring smile when he saw the worried look on his face. Sally stopped halfway through and looked up into his eyes. “You don’t have to do this” he whispered, concern dripping off the words. “I know, but I want to” he said. Keeping his eyes locked with Sally’s willing him to understand, he had to go back in, he needed to see this through, there was so much to learn still he thought.

With a nod Sally finished strapping him in, ensuring that he was comfortable, Sally gently placed the ball in his hand. Lucas lightly squeezed it feeling the electric tingle to ensure it worked.

“Someone else can do this” Sally said, Lucas nodded “they could, but I have to do this Sally, if anything happens it’s on me” Lucas finished. “No son, if anything happens, I will get to carry that, you will be dead, so don’t let it” he said finally backing away from the vertical bed. Lucas could see the tears welling in the man’s eyes and nodded at him “I will come back” he said with as much confidence as he could muster.

Joe woke looking up at the shadows as they passed over the ceiling in his room. The light he had next to the bed was one he had since childhood; shadows of dinosaurs danced across the ceiling like a never-ending Jurassic parade. He knew it was immature, but it helped him sleep, it was one of his few guilty pleasures. Rising from the bed he went the shower.

Looking in the mirror Lucas could finally see the reflection of the older man who was his relation. Back in the lab he squeezed the ball tightly, willing his mind to remember the separation.

Joe finished in the bathroom and got dressed. The conversation from the day before still on his mind. Why had James Marcus asked him about the president. That was unlike him, Joe wasn’t sure what about the question bothered him, but it had sounded like a test and one that he might have failed. Shaking it off he made his way to command and control.

Lucas watched through the eyes of his great grandfather feeling the thoughts and doubts of the conversation. His era had left him with a healthy mistrust of any corporate executive but that was a sentiment his relation didn’t share. But still Lucas could see how much it had bothered him as he rolled the questions over and over in his head.

As Joe entered the C in C he could see Major Helen Wong standing in the center of the room surveying the crew that was currently on duty. Helen was short only standing about five three, but she was a force to be reckoned with. She never yelled but with a glare of her round face and her normally pleasant Asian features could quickly change to feature severe dislike towards any crewmember. Joe smiled, he knew that when Helen had command, everything ran smoothly, more so than when he or bobby took over.

“Commander” Helen nodded as Joe entered the room. They no longer called attention on deck as was the custom when a Senior officer entered, Joe disliked the interruption it caused and unlike his predecessor didn’t need the ego boost. “Whats going on Helen” he asked and watched her wince, she was one of the officers who liked the strict military protocol and was usually annoyed with him for using her first name, but she would never say anything to him , that would be questioning a senior officer and that was something you just didn’t do in her opinion, unless he was drastically incorrect or about to make a wrong call, then. It was done gently, in private and with tact.

She smiled at Joe and nodded again. “We have had some interesting activity, but its not something I can track back as of yet, but we are working on it” she said pointing at the holo table where data streamed down from the ceiling towards the floor.

Joe walked over and began reading it, suddently his good day had taken a turn for the worst. “Is this right?” he asked Helen, not believing what he was seeing.

She came up next to him and glanced at the data “That is correct sir, we have four thousand cases of an unknown virus come into the hospitals over the last three days, all over the world” she stated. Joe shook his head. “How is it we are only hearing about this now?” he wondered, and before her commander could anger, she quickly explained. “Sir, four thousand cases all over the globe is not a lot, it’s the fact that the virus seems identical, and at first glance not one of the victims have anything in common, which is why it finally hit our radar” she explained, and Joe nodded.

Joe read over the symptoms, it read like the flu, only worse. “Okay, let’s keep an eye on it and also let’s run vectors going back six months to see if we can find a common denominator, or a patient zero, let’s hope this thing is isolated” he said, but not believing it. Helen nodded “We have run vectors going back three months, Ill order that expanded , so far nothing we can find that links the patients, but we will keep digging, I have also put out an alert to the CDC and asked any hospital that comes across a case to notify us. So far, they are quarantining the patients and running tests to see what they can find out, we have a call later today with Dr. Lauren McCartney of the CDC.” She finished and Joe nodded. Lucas however, shuddered as he read the information, this was something he knew well and also knew that it would only get worse.

But this was something that happened long ago for him.  Joe officially took over command allowing Helen to take off and get some sleep, He held herself well, but after years of serving with her, he knew the signs and the woman was running on empty. “Oh, before you go, when is the install for the new modules, the ones that Gossamer is doing themselves” Joe asked curiously. Hellen nodded “Yes, they will be starting that tomorrow , some of our systems will go down temporarily, but they tell me the interruptions will be minor, apparently they have been doing upgrades all up and down government facilities for the last year, ours will be one of the last” she finished.

Joe settled in as Helen left to get some much-needed rest. It was a few hours into Joe’s shift that things began to get worse. “Sir” called one of the techs on duty motioning him over. “We are picking up a lot more cases of this virus, they are compounding hourly now, the current count is six thousand, so far no one is able to ascertain its point of origin or even if its natural or man-made” she stated. Joe pulled the data to the holo table reviewing it. “Notify CDC and USAAMRID of the findings and see what their people are tracking, I meet with CDC in thirty minutes, let’s get the army on the call too” he stated and with a nod the tech went to work.

Joe just stared at the data as it lazily scrolled down over the table. Lucas however felt chills, he knew the symptoms and had studied them in great length in history class. In the memory lab seventy Lucas whispered “Bio Plague” causing both Sally and Doc to look up with a start for a moment.

Joe spent the next thirty minutes trying to find any clue to the puzzle of data that kept pouring in, another five hundred cases were discovered in that time. Something was happening and he didn’t think it was going to get better anytime soon. Bobby Ramirez showed up to relieve him, and Joe thanked his second in command. “I hate to leave this in your lap bobby, but once I am done with the doctors, I will be back” Joe said after bringing him up to speed. The sunny mood Bobby had come in with soured quickly as he too reviewed the information on the table.

Joe headed for the private conference room, his mind still rolling the data over in his head. Walking into the room he touched the metal pad next to the door, turning the color from green to red, instantly the windows surrounding the room went opaque. What no one saw was that as soon as he turned on the privacy mode, sound and signal dampeners were activated covering the room like a curtain making any listening or eavesdropping of the room impossible.

Joe walked around the large oval glass table and sat at the head, as he watched lasers activated from the ceiling and monochrome 3D images began to render, slowing shaping four other people at the table with him. The image was grainy as the technology was still in development, but it aloud the other people dialing into the system to seem like they were there, pending they were from a planet where wireframe monochrome people existed that was Joe thought suppressing the grin from forming on his face. The four images finished rendering, there motions were slow almost exaggerated as the pinpoint laser holo system tried to keep up with the rendering. Twenty of these systems existed in the nation and were currently being tested for mass distribution, Joe hated these things and would have just preferred a simple video conference. But the room that was used for secure conferences had been outfitted with these and the video conferencing systems removed six months ago.

The green grainy image outlines of Doctor Sharon Tate of the CDC In Georgia, Colonel Kalman Grey MD of US Army Center for Disease in Fort Detrick MD, Jason Rentschler from the London Center for Disease Surveillance and Marcus Gottlieb from the Robert Koch Institute in Germany sat looking expectantly at Joe.

“By now you have all been brought up to speed of the cases both in your home nations and world-wide, from what we are seeing here at Wolfpack is that the virus strains are the same, but the locations don’t line up with any common denominator that we can discover.” Joe began

“We can confirm your findings Joe” Colonel Grey’s rendering stated and seemed to get agreement from the others. “So, without a common vector, is it possible that these are somehow unrelated?” Asked Marcus Gottlieb and before Joe could jump in Sharon answered his question “Marcus, we have samples from Los Angeles, DC and Iowa sent to our lab and we were able to do a deep dive on the pathogen, we found a few disturbing things, first they are the same strain , the likely hood of people in random places all over the earth catching the exact strain would be impossible unless it was a coordinated attack in multiple locations, but we have had no intelligence to support this, however” she began and paused, Joe could tell she didn’t want to say the next part and just knowing that he didn’t think he wanted to hear it. “We have matched the strain to one of ours” and the room erupted into questions and protests and it took Joe the better part of twenty minutes to calm the room down. “Doctor, can you expand on that” he finally said with a hint of irritation in his tone.

Sharon didn’t say anything for a long moment, her rendering removing its glasses and making the motions of cleaning them as he supposed Sharon herself was doing. He had seen her do it before and knew it was something that allowed the older woman to gather her thoughts before speaking.

“What I mean, is this is one of the strains we share with the UK for research, it is a lab grown strain of H1N2 that has been weaponized, the genetic markers hold the serial indicators of its type, origin and Lab it was created in and it was created right here at the CDC in Georgia” she finished and Joe mashed the mute button before the room could erupt yet again into a cacophony of questions and protests. “If we are going to do this in a productive manner, then each person needs to ask questions one at a time, Dr. Grey, you first” he said and then lifted his finger off the button to a silent audience.

Dr. Grey took his time Joe could imagine the man sitting back astounded at the revelation that had just been dropped on them. In the memory lab Lucas tensed, as if watching a critical piece of history similar to the pearl harbor attack or the first plane turning towards the towers in New York, his senses were focused as he took in every detail of the events as they unfolded.

The room was silent for a long moment as everyone digested that. Finally, Joe spoke up, his voice cracking a little as he asked the question, he feared the answer to. “What do you mean ours?” and waited for Sharon as she again cleaned her glasses for a maddingly long time. “It means Joe, that the originating Virus came from this lab, in fact from the cryo storage vault a hundred feet below my feet, it was a weaponized strain that we confiscated about twenty years ago and kept for research, according to our computer records , it’s still there , untouched.

But we matched the artificial markers on the DNA to that very specimen, I have technicians down there now trying to lay eyes on it, but I don’t think we will find it, or at least not all of it” she finished, her voice neutral and again the room was deathly quiet as everyone thought over that piece of information. “How is that even possible” Joe asked, knowing the layer upon layer those things were kept under. No one could take anything from that vault without triggering alarms, logs or warnings, but that was exactly what Sharon said they had done.

Dr. Grey spoke up “Is it possible, it was from the same batch, but not one that was confiscated?” he mused giving Joe a small bit of hope that was quickly squashed. The rendering of Sharon shook her head. “No, some of the markers were added during research and we made some modifications as well, it’s definitely ours” she answered, Joe could hear the discomfort in her voice and wondered what she meant by “modifications”.

Dr. Rentschler beat him to it “What type of modifications Doctor?” he asked in that calm precise tone that only a German could pull off.

Dr. Tate sat even through the monochrome rendering Joe could see the uncomfortable shift and the grimace on her face, that’s not good he thought leaning forward, like a traffic accident, you didn’t want to see it, but you couldn’t help but look he waited for her answer as did the others around the table.

“In the effort to better understand weapon development, we ran a few … tests” Dr. Tate stated wincing at her own use of the last word. “Tests?” Joe pressed, he could smell something off about it, the creating of biological weapons was banned, but had they tried to get around that by running experiments on an existing one?” he wondered. Dr. Tate remained silent, but the damage was done, everyone at the table could understand the logic that would have gone into testing with an existing weapon , the ability to understand how to push a virus further, the justification for the need to understand and despite everyone’s thought, not a person at the table Joe thought, had would push, or judge her because he was sure , the US wasn’t the only nation working with weapons from existing virus stocks, even for pure research purposes.

“So if this was actually taken from one of our labs, we need to make it a priority to figure out how, I don’t have to tell everyone the only way this could have happened was , that someone among out most trusted and Senior staff would have to be involved” Dr. Grey stated, though his words were dispassionate, the resonance of his tone and the words expressed a horror everyone there feared. Someone in the CDC inner circle was a traitor or a zealot.

Dr. Tate’s Rendering nodded “We will find out who and report back, but that doesn’t help us with the current situation, we need all hands on this, if we don’t find a cure to this, it could become a worldwide Pandemic and fast” and everyone agreed.

The meeting concluded with agreements from the labs to begin working with the Virus type as soon as they received it to try and find a possible inoculation, but not a person at the table thought that could be done, and that left Joe with unenviable task of working on something he never thought he would have to , Global triage should this explode.

Walking out of the privacy room and back to the C in C his mood had soured even worse. “Bobby, I need you to stay in charge, I have a few calls to make” Joe told him as he made his way to his office. He walked in and closed the door and leaning on it, closing his eyes, he did his best to try to instill a sense of calm within him. Opening his eyes, he walked over to his desk and dialed a number he had committed to memory when receiving this command, one he wished to never call. “This is Wolf Pack; we have an ARC situation” he said into the phone.

Lucas’s eyes fluttered open and took a few moments to focus on the two dark blobs in front of him. The worried faces of Sally and Doc stared at him. “Are you okay?” the doc asked shining a light in his eyes. Lucas looked around trying to resolve where he was, he had just been in his office, in Joes office he corrected. “What, what happened” Lucas croaked, realizing at once the room was spinning, he felt parched, like out in the desert for days parched. Sally winced at the sound of his voice and quickly went over to the desk to pour water. The Doc stayed steady with a disapproving look on her face. “I will tell you what happened, you stopped squeezing the ball and your brain patterns began to alter, so I pulled you out, I told you not to lose yourself in there” She said in a scolding tone.

“Shit” Lucas whispered, she was right, he had been so focused on watching and listening to what was going on that he lost his way. “Okay, well take a break” he said, and the Doc shook her head “No, we are done” she said vehemently. Sally came back over concern on his face. “Let’s just take it slow, take the night and then we will talk” he said making a calming gesture with his hands.

Lucas was unstrapped and went back to his room with the doc still railing at Sally over this. Lucas knew he needed to ensure that didn’t happen again.

He was sitting on the edge of his bed thinking of all he had learned when a soft knock came at the door. “Come in” Lucas said without looking. The door opened and Sally entered the room “You Okay?” he asked Lucas could see the concern written all over his face. “I am, thanks for pulling me out today” he said forcing a sheepish grin on his face. Sally came over “don’t thank me, the doc made the call, she might be a pain in the ass, but she cares, and she is dedicated” he said as if arguing against something that Lucas wasn’t thinking. “I know, and I appreciate it, but I can handle this, there is so much that I am finding out” he said and then filled Sally in on the day’s events, He sat there spellbound as he listened. “This is not in any of the records, this is history that has been lost, but I am not sure how it can help us now?” he said Lucas knew he was thinking of the armory and he could understand the singular goal. “Because we might learn something, something we can use, aside from the armory code, which we still could learn, I need to go back Sally, I can’t explain it” Lucas said frustration evident in his tone. Sally nodded “okay, we will talk about it in the morning, here doc gave me these” and he handed Lucas a bottle of pills “these will be for the pain” he finished and then walked out of the room without another word, Lucas watched him go, he knew the old man was worried for him, but even with that, he knew he couldn’t stop, there was something there, something they needed to know, and he would find out what it was, he would finish this” he thought as he laid back and allowed sleep to slowly take him.

Lucas awoke the next morning again with a massive headache “this is getting old” he whispered, taking two of the pills that Sally had dropped off the night before. Lucas laid there waiting for the pounding to stop, even though the headache had returned, none of the other side effects had, he wondered if the more times he went in the better it would get, there was only one way to find out he thought. What the hell was the ARC, the doc had pulled him out before he had been able to find out more, from Joe’s thoughts it was something important, something critical.

After a while Lucas got up groaning as he shifted his head and the rock that was his brain protested in spades. There was so much they didn’t know, and Lucas was on the cusp of finding answers to questions they never even knew to ask he thought his resolve to go back solidifying.

Lucas made his way to the Main room, realizing he was starving having missed breakfast and lunch. The main hall was empty, and Lucas went about making himself a bowl of cereal and a piece of dried fruit. He ate with gusto lost in thought as he tried to think through the events of the day before, So lost in thought he just about jumped out of his skin when Rolle laid a hand on his shoulder “Shit” Lucas hissed , jumping up from the chair and spinning around to see the big white smile “Damn man, didn’t mean to scare you” Rolle laughed and Lucas deflated, smiling at his friend, yeah I didn’t hear you coming. “Dyson trained you better fool” he said slapping Lucas on the shoulder. Lucas felt guilty, he was right, Dyson had, what was wrong with him he thought. What was the draw to this other world to this history, it wasn’t like it was events he could change, but he needed to know, and the curiosity was all consuming? Smiling at Rolle he offered him half the dried fruit, Rolle took it and bit in wincing at the bitter taste of the banana.

“So, I hear the Doc went full on crazy while you were in the hot seat” Rolle said conversationally. Lucas looked curiously at him “She pulled me out, and she was a bit pissed, but I don’t know about that” he said trying to think back to the day before, he had been a bit out of it. “No Emma said she and Sally were screaming at each other for a good twenty minutes before you were pulled” he said all kidding aside. Lucas looked down “Well, it was my fuck up” he finally said and then went back to eating the cereal. Rolle didn’t pursue it instead made his own breakfast and sat down across from Lucas.

They talked about Lucas’s last trip he filled Rolle in on everything he saw and heard “So, what do you think the ARC is?” he asked He looked up at Rolle shaking his head “I have no idea and I was pulled before I could find out” he said, he couldn’t hide his frustration and then winced, Doc had done it to protect him, not to interrupt or hurt him and honestly she had been right.

They finished their breakfast in silence both thinking over what had been revealed in the machine, both now vested in finding out more. Once he was done, Lucas made his way back to the memory lab. Walking in he found himself alone he stood there, quietly looking at the bed, every strap and every lead that led into the machine. The device was amazing, magical almost he thought standing there remembering how it felt to live as another, even though that life had been decades in the past.

“Rethinking your desire to go back?” Came Sally’s voice from behind him, Lucas turned to see the man smiling at him “No, just thinking how amazing it is” he said returning the smile. Sally shook his head “be careful in there, we almost lost you yesterday, I don’t want a repeat performance” he said all kidding aside. Lucas nodded “Sorry, I got wrapped up, it won’t happen again” he answered almost pleadingly, he had to go back, he had to find out how this played out. “Your damn right it won’t” came the doctor’s voice from the door, both of them turned around to see the severe looking woman as she stood there assessing them.

“Well, it’s obvious I am not going to talk you out of it, so let’s get to it” she said all business. The doctor silently setup as Sally strapped Lucas in.
